show.title: Aloo Bhindi Ka Pyaar
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/6WcTV4
show.description: In the dramatic "Sabzi Mandi," Aloo and Bhindi defy their traditional families and a jealous Gobi to protect their forbidden romance. Their journey leads them through a high-stakes vegetable courtroom and a stint in "Cold Storage" before proving their innocence. With the support of friends, they escape the label of being "rotten" to perform a sacred "Kadhai Marriage". Ultimately, their families unite, realizing their world-famous combo is powered by true love.
